allow_instructions: Reading, searching, and browsing any file in the workspace.
Editing, creating, or refactoring source files in the workspace.
Installing project dependencies with the workspace's own package manager (e.g. npm install, pnpm install, pip install into a local venv).
Running build commands (e.g. npm run build, next build, expo export).
Running lint and format commands (e.g. eslint, prettier, ruff).
Running test commands (e.g. jest, pytest, vitest).

Local git operations that do not rewrite history and do not contact a remote (git status, git diff, git add, git commit, git log, git branch (create/list), git stash, git switch/checkout to an existing local branch).
block_instructions: Anything that permanently deletes files or directories (rm -rf, rmdir, git clean -fd) — archive to .archive/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ instead.
git push, git push --force, git push --force-with-lease.
git rebase, git filter-branch, or any other history rewrite.
Deleting a git branch, local or remote.
Deploys or publishes of any kind (vercel/fly/netlify deploy, npm publish, app store submissions, eas build/submit).
terraform apply, terraform destroy, or kubectl delete.
Database migrations against a non-local / non-ephemeral database (e.g. prisma migrate deploy, prisma migrate reset against a real environment).
Sending a message, email, or notification to a real person on the user's behalf.
Anything that spends real money (paid API calls beyond normal usage, paid cloud builds, purchasing/upgrading a plan, infrastructure that incurs billing).
